latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of binance-spot-trader: an autonomous Binance spot trading bot with LLM-powered market analysis.

- Supports momentum, mean reversion, and DCA (Dollar Cost Averaging) strategies across any Binance spot pair
- Integrates technical analysis and LLM sentiment evaluation for enhanced trade filtering
- Allows position sizing, portfolio tracking, and configuration via environment variables
- Offers security best practices and setup instructions for safe deployment
- Requires Binance API keys and SkillBoss API key for operation
